title: Coast Explorer ABC
hook: Look twice, listen once—what do you know?
Find the clue, then let the letter show!
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: colorful explorer-storybook 3D coast art, friendly field-guide feel, beach palette, bold clean foreground separation

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: curious coast explorer using eyes, hands and pretend binoculars
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: explorer badge hook with clap-ready paired cadence
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written field-guide observations driven by internal rhyme, alliteration, consonance, and occasional delayed end-rhyme rather than regular couplets
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: brief recall gap followed by gesture or pretend-binocular action without generic point-and-say repetition
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 claves and guitar; chorus adds claps; Round 2 uses muted guitar plus sparse marimba clues
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: two-clave explorer tick before section turns
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make every letter feel like field evidence in a young explorer's notebook: notice one telling shape, motion, texture, sound, or function and let that clue earn the line.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: Clipped observation language, sensory evidence, and notebook-like clue phrases. Internal rhyme/alliteration should sound like quick pencil marks—drop/stop, slip/slide, wing/wind—not ornamental nursery filler.
semanticArc: close the notebook with a coast full of remembered clues
